name: Appeal
desc: When entering battle, if the team has an opposite-sex Susuta family member, increases own BREAK efficiency by 30% for 15s. Cooldown: 20s.

name: Arc Surge
desc: Teammates who receive this Aniimo's skill buff also gain 25% Lightning damage for 15s.

name: Biting Wind
desc: When dealing damage to targets with more than 5 stacks of [Ice Debuff], increases critical rate of that damage by 15%.

name: Counter Strike
desc: After being attacked, increases BREAK efficiency by 30% for 10s.

name: Earth Affinity
desc: While in [Tunneling] state, can cast skills and deals 30% extra BREAK.

name: Scorching Flames
desc: Increases damage dealt to enemies weak to your element by 15%.

name: Tidal Heart
desc: While in water terrain or after absorbing water, increases Water damage by 20% for 10s.

name: Water Spirit
desc: While in water terrain, reduces the EP cost of all skills by 10%.

name: Band Member
desc: When switching Aniimo in battle, restores 12.5 EP to the next Chirpi family member switched in. Triggers once every 20s at most.

name: Battle Fervor
desc: Defeating a target grants 1 stack of Battlelust, increasing damage by 25% for 20s. Stacks up to 2 times.

name: Blazing Flames
desc: Always has 20 stacks of [Fire Debuff]. [Trick Fire Ring] applies 4 stacks of [Fire Debuff], while [Fire Orb] applies 3 stacks of [Fire Debuff].

name: Bloodthirst
desc: For every 1% HP lost, increases damage by 0.8%, up to 48%.

name: Bubble
desc: Every 12s, enters Bathing. The next skill cast creates a puddle.

name: Bubble Energy
desc: Automatically restores 1 [Bubble Energy] every 3s. Each time this Aniimo’s skill deals damage to a target, restores an extra 3. Stores up to 10. Casting [Baa-Baa Healbubb] consumes 10 to restore an extra 12%.

name: Dangerous Fragrance
desc: When a skill deals damage to a target, reduces the target's Dark Resistance by 7% for 20s.

name: Disco Aniimo
desc: While on grass, damage increases by 20%. After entering battle, each skill hit grants 1 [Dance Power]. At 24, the next skill costs no EP.

name: Flutter Heal
desc: When entering battle as the active Aniimo, increases healing by 20%. If off field, appears as a phantom. When other Aniimo cast skills or Ultimates, restores HP equal to 0.5% of max HP.

name: Gachapon
desc: Each basic attack and skill triggers the gacha once, randomly firing an orange, purple, blue, or gold bubble and adding that bubble color to the gacha slots. Gold bubbles have a 1% chance to appear, while each other color has a 33% chance to appear. When the slots hold 5 bubbles of the same color, or when a gold bubble appears, all bubbles are cleared and [Jackpot] begins for 10s. In [Jackpot], basic attacks and skills no longer trigger the gacha and always fire Rainbow Bubbles. Basic attack damage +60%.

name: Grand Sorcerer
desc: For 5s after using a skill, basic attack hits deal additional damage equal to 5 Might.

name: Guardbreak Resonance
desc: Increases BREAK by 0.

name: Hard Winter
desc: After casting 3 skills, enhances the next skill used during Icebreaker and adds an extra effect.When HP is below 75%, increases BREAK efficiency by 20%. When HP is below 50%, increases BREAK efficiency by 40%.

name: Judgment Storm
desc: When a skill applies a debuff to a target, Wind damage for the whole team increases by 20% for 15s.

name: Overcharged Coral
desc: When entering battle, restores 2.5 EP for each Earth-type Aniimo on the team. Cooldown: 15s.

name: Overloaded Engine
desc: Moving and using skills builds Overload Energy. When Overload Energy is full, the next skill gains 40% bonus damage.

name: Potent Erosion
desc: When a skill or Ultimate hits a target, reduces the target’s Earth Resistance by 2%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 10s.

name: Power Sustain
desc: After skills land 6 critical hits, becomes [Overcharged], immediately gaining a shield equal to 5% HP. All skills cost 12 less EP, but UP cannot be gained. Lasts 6s.

name: Pyro Charge
desc: After spending a total of  EP, gains [Pyro Charge]. Every 502s, applies 1 stack of Fire Debuff to nearby targets for 10s.

name: Raging Rampage
desc: Builds [Rage] during battle. Basic attacks grant 2 points, every 10 EP spent on skills grants 10, and taking damage grants 2. At 100 points, enters the [Enraged] state.[Enraged] increases ATK Speed and own skill damage by 30%, increases the EP recovery rate by 25%, and prevents [Rage] gain. Lasts 20s.

name: Shrouded in Mist
desc: After using 6 basic attacks, enters [Shrouded in Mist] state. Casting a skill consumes this state to enhance the skill's effects.

name: Stealth
desc: Skills build Momentum when they deal damage, up to 6 stacks. Momentum gain is doubled during tunneling. At max stacks, increases BREAK efficiency by 30% for 15s.

name: Sword Dance
desc: Each skill used grants 1 stack of [Sword Dance], up to 4 stacks, lasting 15s. Each basic attack costs 1 stack of [Sword Dance] to deal 180% extra damage.

name: Thunderbond
desc: When this Aniimo's attack hits a target, it gains 1 stack of [Thunderbond]. At 30 stacks, it enters the [Thunderwing Stance] when using its next skill or Ultimate. Lasts 10s.

name: Tuning
desc: Each skill cast grants 1 stack of [Volume], up to 6 stacks. At 6 stacks of [Volume], increases critical rate by 15% for 15s.

name: Air Superiority
desc: Increases critical rate by 20% while flying.

name: Counting Sheep
desc: Every 10s, the next skill applies 1 stack of [Drowsiness] to the target. At 3 stacks, the target enters [Nightmare] for 20s. Targets in [Nightmare] have their Dark Resistance reduced by 17% and cannot move or cast skills for 3s. Taking damage removes the control effect.

name: Electro Stash
desc: Restores 4 EP when a skill lands a critical hit.

name: Energized
desc: For every 1,000 max HP, increases BREAK damage by 2%.

name: Energy Full
desc: Increases max EP by 10.

name: Frostbite Sunder
desc: Basic attacks apply [Ice Debuff]. Deals 35% extra BREAK to targets with more than 5 stacks of [Ice Debuff].

name: Full Energy
desc: After using 8 basic attacks in battle, Inferlupa enters Full Energy, enhancing its next skill. Damage dealt by that skill is treated as basic attack damage.

name: Lunar Power
desc: When not attacking with an advantageous element, final damage increases by 20%.Casting a skill or Ultimate grants 4 stacks of [Silver Moon Mark]. Each basic attack hit consumes 1 stack, deals 100% extra damage, and restores 0.5% HP.

name: Phantom Opening
desc: When a teammate deals basic attack damage, gains 1 stack of [Rose Mark], up to 10 stacks. Each stack of [Rose Mark] reduces Melloblum's EP cost by 3.

name: Power of Fire
desc: Deals 40% extra damage to enemies with more than 5 stacks of Fire Debuff.

name: Power of Nature
desc: While off field, creates a patch of grass under a teammate after they cast 3 skills.

name: Power Surge
desc: When casting a skill with less than 20 EP, restores 2.5 EP.

name: Prank
desc: Every 18s, the next skill applies [Curse] to enemies hit for 10s. Dark basic attacks restore 0.25 EP when hitting enemies with [Curse].

name: Prank Master
desc: Increases BREAK damage by % for every 21,000 max HP. Upon entering battle, summons 1 Hummin to assist. An additional Hummin is summoned every 10s, up to a maximum of 3.

name: Pursuit
desc: Deals 30% extra damage to targets affected by control effects or BREAK.

name: Radiant Charm
desc: Increases Water damage by12% for all opposite-sex Aniimo on the team.

name: Rock Empowerment
desc: [Rock Piles] created by Bouldus can be destroyed by Waleetle's [Stone Ball Drift], releasing shock waves and applying [Disintegration] to the target.[Disintegration]: Each stack reduces Earth Resistance by 3%% and Movement Speed by 5% for 20s. Stacks up to 6 times.

name: Solar Grace
desc: When not attacking with an advantageous element, final damage increases by 20%. Every 4 basic attacks grants [Solar Halo], enhancing the next skill.

name: Spotlight Moment
desc: The first skill this Aniimo uses within 5s of entering battle does not consume EP. Cooldown: 17s.

name: Victory Concerto
desc: While shielded, BREAK efficiency +40%.When triggering BREAK, plays [Concerto], reducing the whole team's stamina cost by 30%.When you have 3 Movement-series buffs, increases all Movement effects by 30%.
